name: Neural Voxel Renderer
aliases: Neural Voxel Renderer — NVR, Neural Voxel Renderer (NVR)
definition: A neural network that takes a voxel representation of a scene and a light position as input to produce a rendered image, implicitly learning to map discrete geometric representations (voxels) to continuous and smooth renderings.
summary: The Neural Voxel Renderer is a neural network that converts discrete voxel grids and light positions into photorealistic images using a dual-branch architecture and perceptual loss.
